title: PG&E Corporation Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: PGE Corporation (NYSE: PCG) will hold a conference call on Thursday, July 23, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time (8:00 a.m. Pacific Time) to discuss its second quarter 2026 results. The public can access the conference call through a simultaneous webcast. The link is provided below and will also be available from the PGE Corporation website. What: Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call When: Thursday, July 23, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time Where: http://investor.pgecorp.com/news-events/events-and-presentations/default.aspx A replay of the live conference call and webcast will be available at http://investor.pgecorp.com/news-events/events-and-presentations/default.aspx . Alternatively, a toll-free replay of the conference call may be accessed shortly after the live call through July 30, 2026 by dialing (800) 770-2030. Confirmation code 92587 will be required to access the replay. Please contact Investor Relations at invrel@pge-corp.com if you have any questions. PGE
